lines.zh: 我贴着落叶滑过去，没有脚。
lines.en: I slide over the leaf litter without feet.

lines.zh: 我的身体画出一个又一个S。
lines.en: My body draws S after S.

lines.zh: 鳞片刮过枯叶，声音很细。
lines.en: My scales rasp the dead leaves, very faint.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，没有碰。
lines.en: I flow around a stone without touching it.
I slip under a root.

lines.zh: 我的头抬得不高，刚好过草。
lines.en: My head rides just above the grass.

lines.zh: 我顺着一段倒木往前走。
lines.en: I travel along a fallen log.
A curved line is left in the wet soil.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，舌头探出来。
lines.en: I pause and my tongue slips out.

lines.zh: 我朝着有热气的地方去。
lines.en: I head toward warmth.
I slip into a crack in the rock. Narrow.
I come out the other side.
I coil with my head resting on my body.

lines.zh: 我的花纹让地面变得不好看清。
lines.en: My pattern makes the ground hard to read.

lines.zh: 舌头一伸一缩，一直在尝空气。
lines.en: My tongue flicks, tasting the air.

lines.zh: 我很安静，安静是我的本事。
lines.en: I am quiet. Quiet is my craft.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我的一段背上。
lines.en: Sun falls across a length of my back.

lines.zh: 有一片叶子落在我身上。
lines.en: A leaf settles on me.
I do not move. Let it stay.
I draw one loop tighter.

lines.zh: 这附近的鼠洞我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the rodent burrows near here.
Rain is coming; I coil tighter.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来一点，又放下。
lines.en: I lift my head a little, then lower it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛上有一条深色的纹。
lines.en: A dark band runs through my eye.
I wait for a tremor in the ground.
I only stir as the light fails.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边，你没有低头。
lines.en: I am at your feet and you have not looked down.
I raise my head, a hand's height.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的话，我会先动。
lines.en: If you step here, I move first.

lines.zh: 我的舌头尝到你的味道。
lines.en: My tongue tastes you.
You are not what I am looking for.

lines.zh: 但你的脚挡住了我的路。
lines.en: But your foot blocks my way.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，比刚才亮了一点。
lines.en: I coil, a little brighter than before.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我就松开了。
lines.en: You take half a step back and I relax.
Let us each go our own way. Yes?

lines.zh: 矛头蝮的牙，从不等你反应。
lines.en: A lancehead's fangs don't wait for you.
You cannot see me. That is normal.

lines.zh: 我现在就贴在你的影子里。
lines.en: I lie in your shadow right now.
Do not move. Back away slowly.
I will give you time.
When you go, I continue.

lines.zh: 这一带本来没有你的位置。
lines.en: There was no place for you here to begin with.

lines.zh: 但我不打算为这个浪费毒。
lines.en: But I will not waste venom on that.
Your luck is not bad.
I coil tight at once and raise my head.
My body twists once.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了几片，还是很利。
lines.en: Lost a few scales — the rest still sharp.

lines.zh: 石缝里凉，我先把头藏进去。
lines.en: The crevice is cool; I hide my head first.
This has slowed me.
I open my mouth without a sound.

lines.zh: 信子收回，我听见你靠近。
lines.en: My tongue retracts; I hear you near.
I am finding my direction again.
The pain leaves me numb.
But I can still move.
That smell is small, and alive.
My head has risen a little.
I slide toward it.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，很好。
lines.en: You set it on the ground. Good.
I do not snatch. I wait for you to move back.
Too small. Barely a mouthful.
I swallow it whole.
That is how a snake eats.
Afterward I will find a warm stone.
If you have more, set it down again.
You step on the leaves beside me.
I coil, hiding my fangs in the loops.

lines.zh: 我的头抬到能碰到你的高度。
lines.en: My head rises to where it could reach you.
I dislike that very much.
I slide back a foot.
You are blocking my direction.
I slip around your boot.

lines.zh: 鳞片在你鞋上蹭了一下。
lines.en: My scales rasp your boot.
Do not kick. If you do, I will respond.

lines.zh: 我的三角头，贴着地滑过来。
lines.en: My triangular head slides along the ground.
Another slides out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我们并排盘着，头对着头。
lines.en: We coil side by side, head to head.

lines.zh: 我的舌头碰到她的舌头。
lines.en: My tongue touches hers.
We slide onto the warm stone together.

lines.zh: 花纹交叠在一起，看不清了。
lines.en: Our patterns overlap and become unreadable.

lines.zh: 她游过落叶，我跟在鳞迹后。
lines.en: She glides over leaves; I follow her trail.
The ground is warm this season.

lines.zh: 我们会在同一个洞里过夜。
lines.en: We will pass the night in the same hollow.
At daybreak we part.
That is already enough.
I test it with my snout.
Too large. I cannot swallow it.

lines.zh: 我用吻端把它推到落叶下。
lines.en: I nudge it under the fallen leaves.
Not alive. I am not interested.
It is caught inside my coils.
I loosen and it drops.

lines.zh: 我用身子绕住它，试着挪。
lines.en: I wrap it and try to shift it.
This is rather cool.
I push it under a stone.
Someone will come looking here.
The ground trembles, faintly.
My head turns that way.
A rat. Not large.
Enough for one meal.
I draw myself into a line.

lines.zh: 我的舌头尝到了它的方向。
lines.en: My tongue has its direction.
It is still coming this way.
I press myself to the ground.
It has stepped into my reach.
I raise my head.
It did not see at all.
Half an arm's length only.

lines.zh: 我把头抬到出击的高度。
lines.en: I raise my head to striking height.
Still. One more step.

lines.zh: 矛头蝮的毒牙，已经立起来。
lines.en: My fangs are already raised.
Bite now.
I slide after its steps.
It stops; I stop too.
My head stays on it.
My tongue goes out and back.
It keeps to the wall's base.
I cut it off from the other side.
It is beginning to panic.

lines.zh: 这种反应我见过很多次。
lines.en: I have seen that reaction many times.
It runs for its burrow.
I am already inside the burrow mouth.
It backs out again.
We circle.
It cannot run fast.
My body is long.
It cannot leave this circle.
Half an inch more.

lines.zh: 矛头一样的头，抬起来了。
lines.en: This lance-shaped head has risen.
This will make no sound.
I strike, and the fangs go in.
The venom moves slowly, but surely.
It leaps once, then goes limp.
I let go and pull back half a step.
I wait for it to stop moving.
Then I swallow it head first.
Swallowing takes a long while.
My jaw opens a little at a time.
My whole body pushes.
Afterward I can barely move.
I coil there and digest.
I will not strike again for days.
If something approaches, I will not care.
I am too full.
The sun is on me. Good.
I close my eyes.
I slide out from under the dead leaves.
Soil still clings to my scales.
This wood is damp. Just right.
I raise my head and taste the air.

lines.zh: 有鼠，有鸟，还有更大的东西。
lines.en: Rats, birds, and something larger.
Coiling up slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 我的花纹和落叶一个颜色。
lines.en: My pattern matches the fallen leaves.
This ground is mine to cross now.
I rest my head on my coils.
First wait for dark.

lines.zh: 天黑之后，地面会热闹起来。
lines.en: After dark, the ground grows busy.
I will move then.
I come out from under a stone.

lines.zh: 我的头先探出去，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My head goes first; the rest follows.

lines.zh: 落叶盖住我一半的身子。
lines.en: Fallen leaves cover half of me.
I slide a stretch along the rock seam.
The soil here is loose and easy to enter.

lines.zh: 我停在一处向阳的石头边。
lines.en: I stop beside a sun-warmed stone.

lines.zh: 火烫到我的背，我猛地弹开。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and I snap away.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑落，摔成一团。
lines.en: I slide off the stone and land in a heap.

lines.zh: 水漫过我，我扭着往上挣。
lines.en: Water covers me; I twist upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀起来，我落地时散开了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up; I land uncoiled.

lines.zh: 箭穿过鳞片，我缠住箭杆。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my scales; I coil around its shaft.
A force locks me in place.

lines.zh: 太久没吃，我连盘都盘不稳。
lines.en: Too long without food; I can barely hold a coil.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我整条身体都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole length goes stiff.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我扭着往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I twist downward.
